title: Syria to host 4th Arab Forum for Space Science and Astronomy next Sunday

body:
Kuwait News Agency

DAMASCUS, July 28 (KUNA) — Syria hosts for the first time next Sunday the Fourth Arab Forum for space science and astronomy in Kafr Janna in Aleppo, with the participation of Kuwaiti and 24 Arab and foreign countries under the auspices of the Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences.

The forum is expected to discuss moon sighting especially with the advent of the holy month of Ramadan, in addition to building astronomical observatories in Syria and the Arab world as well as specialized future topics in the fields of space and astronomy.

The State of Kuwait is a member in the Supreme Council of the Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences, which was founded in 1998 in the Jordanian capital Amman. (end).
